name: Wooden Daily Routine Chart
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Material & Structure:

 - Crafted from high-quality layered plywood, this routine chart is built to last. It includes a sturdy detachable wooden stand (base) for convenient tabletop display.

 - Chart board: 3-layered wood, 2mm thick

 - Buttons: 5mm thick wood

 - Wooden Base: 5mm thick wood.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

The product comes in three different size options to suit various needs and spaces:

 - Large: 33.75 × 22.5 cm ~ 13.28  × 8.8 inches

 - Medium: 22.5 × 15 cm ~ 8.85  × 5.9 inches

 - Small: 15 × 10 cm ~ 5.9  × 3.93 inches

  • Wooden Stand dimensions: 

 - Wooden Stand: 11 × 10 × 7 cm ~ 4.3 × 3.9 × 2.7 inches for 2 size options: 5.9  × 3.93 inches and  8.85  × 5.9 inches

 - Wooden Stand: 17x 15 x 10.5 cm ~ 6.69 x 5.91 x 4.13 inches for large size 13.28  × 8.8 inches.

 

  • Printing Technology:

Printed using advanced UV printing technology, the chart features vivid, sharp, and durable graphics. Designs are printed on the front side only, ensuring a clean and neat appearance from the back.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:

This daily routine board helps children build good habits by visually organizing daily tasks. Each task has a movable button, allowing children to mark tasks as completed. Perfect for reinforcing routines such as: Getting dressed, Putting away dirty clothes, Watering plants, Potty time, Feeding pets, Tidying up toys, Finishing dinner, Story time, etc.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A thoughtful and educational gift suitable for kids, parents, and teachers. Ideal for birthdays, holidays, Christmas, back-to-school, or any special occasion. Encourages independence, responsibility, and time management in a fun and engaging way.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wooden Daily Routine Chart , 1x Wooden Stand 

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
